source_title: Zakon o potvrđivanju Ugovora između Vlade Republike Hrvatske i Vlade Narodne Republike Kine o izbjegavanju dvostrukog oporezivanja (NN-MU 3/2001), Croatian text

rates.quote: 2. Međutim te dividende mogu se oporezivati i u državi ugovornici čiji je rezident društvo što plaća dividende i to prema zakonima te države, ali ako je primalac dividendi osoba koja ima pravo korištenja, tada tako razrezan porez ne smije biti veći od 5% od bruto iznosa dividendi.

2. Međutim, takve kamate mogu se oporezivati i u državi ugovornici u kojoj su nastale i to prema zakonima te države; ali ako je primalac kamata osoba koja ima pravo korištenja, porez ne smije biti veći od 10% od bruto iznosa kamata.

2. Međutim te autorske naknade mogu se oporezivati u državi ugovornici u kojoj su nastale, i to prema zakonima te države, ali ako je primatelj autorske naknade osoba koja ima pravo korištenja, porez ne smije preći 10% od bruto iznosa autorske naknade.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of a Covered Tax Agreement, a benefit under the Covered Tax Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of the Covered Tax Agreement. [MLI Art. 7(1) applies (China list 'Croatia Original 09-01-1995 18-05-2001'; Croatia lists the Agreement as No. 11); WHT effect 2023-01-01 per Art. 35(1)(a).]

notes: Art. 28: applies to income derived in tax years beginning on or after 1 January of the year following entry into force (2001-05-18 -> 2002-01-01). Flat 5% dividend rate for all beneficial owners. Art. 11(3): interest derived by the other State's government, local authorities, central bank or State-owned financial institutions, or on debt indirectly financed by them, exempt at source (not modelled). MLI Art. 8 not relevant (single dividend rate; Croatia reserved Art. 8). Quotes from the Croatian text with PDF-extraction spacing artefacts (e.g. 'ć i') normalised; English text prevails in case of divergence.
